checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: 6-second 16:9 video of mountain lake at dusk
must.why: Frames are 826x496 (about 16:9) and show a dusk mountain lake. Duration is stated as 6 s.

must.item: Gentle ripples visibly animate the water
must.why: Frames show faint ripple texture, and the cloud reflections differ across frames. Ripple motion itself can't be confirmed from stills.

must.item: Camera fixed, no pans, zooms or cuts
must.why: The mountain outlines and horizon are in identical positions in every frame.

must.item: Loop has no perceptible jump at the boundary
must.why: The first and last frames are first and last by design, and the 5.7 s frame is nearly identical to the start. A hidden jump can't be fully excluded.

must.item: Centre stays calm, no prominent moving foreground objects
must.why: The centre is open sky and calm water. Only small clouds drift in the mid-sky.

must.item: No visible text and no audible sound
must.why: No text is visible. The user was told audio is off.

faults.what: Clouds appear and dissolve over the loop. The source image had none, so this is unrequested and could read as a slight pulse in the sky behind the heading.
Resolution is only 480p and looks soft.

summary: A calm, still-camera dusk mountain lake loop with a matching start and end frame; the only drawbacks are clouds that fade in and out mid-clip and the soft 480p resolution.
